static_traits.name: 凯拉
static_traits.medical_history: 既往not yet出现类似心理问题；without心理治疗史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能具体描述trigger情境与自动化思维

basic_info.main_problem: 在工作中丢失一笔销售后出现强烈的负性情绪与恐惧，倾向于灾难化并对not yet来作出负性预测（如担心家人将迎来糟糕的圣诞节），导致Work performance affected、Tense relationships with colleagues以及睡眠、食欲受影响。
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的对not yet来事件的负性Anticipation和灾难化开始影响我的心理健康并影响工作表现，这促使我寻求咨询。

special_situations.event: 今天在工作中丢失一笔大单
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I lose an order today, I will keep failing from then on, and it will affect the family's holidays and life
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图保持积极，专注下一个机会
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我再也成交not了下一单了

special_situations.event: 午休的安静时刻，在丢单后独自思考
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not立刻阻止这些想法，它们会吞噬我，让一切更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention by walking or listening to music, preventing a negative thinking spiral
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From now on, everything will go downhill

special_situations.event: Thinking of Christmas family expenses and income pressure, linked with losing an order that day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If performance declines, it will directly cause the family to have a bad Christmas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前预演最坏情形以获得心理准备与控制感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这会让我们的圣诞节很糟

special_situations.event: Positive evidence appears or is pointed out (for example, having lost an order then closing a bigger one the following week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果积极结果without法持续，就not值得被纳入评估
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 淡化或negate正面结果，以维持谨慎与对风险的警惕
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那只是侥幸，这次not会好转

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, to gain stable work performance and life security
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败导致收入下降、让家人失望并被同事negate
defense_goal: Gaining a sense of control and psychological preparation by imagining the worst outcome in advance
维持高度警觉以避免再次失败

object_relations.self_representation: 容易失败并被评判的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、会negate自己的同事或客户

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the realism of these negative predictions or asked to recall positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为积极例证只是侥幸，without法改变整体走向（移情：将希望视为not可靠）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone, first validating her emotions, then using concretizing follow-up questions to guide her to distinguish facts from speculation, encouraging her to list counterexamples and evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在与同事互动时察觉他人情绪或眼神后
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为同事都能感受到并negate自己的能力（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use澄清与界定边界的Questioning，邀请区分事实与推测；语气稳定、not评判，鼓励具体化描述同事的实际言行。

manifestations: 在工作挫败后对not yet来作出despair化预测（“一切都会走下坡路”）
将单次失败视为整体走向的恶化
担心家庭节日将变糟，感到前景阴郁

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly harsh on her own performance at work and magnifies negative results
失单后反复内心审视并Anticipation最坏
在与同事互动中过度在意他人对自己的看法

exception_events.target_problem: 在丢失一笔销售后，来访者通常会灾难化并预测持续失败，导致Low mood、注意力分散，Work performance affected。
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few months ago, she lost a sale, but closed a bigger deal the following week; the outcome was markedly better than her prediction at the time.
exception_events.reason: not同做法：尝试保持积极并专注于下一个机会的跟进；因此这次出现了与以往灾难化Anticipationnot同的结果。

positive_force: 愿意保持积极并专注下一次机会
Able to recall and acknowledge past positive exceptions (after losing an order, closed a bigger order the next week)
Willing to try concrete strategies (recording positive outcomes, lunchtime walks/listening to music)
配合度高、对改变持希望态度
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、negate积极的认知模式
对失败的恐惧与对not yet来的负性Anticipation
业绩与收入压力导致整体Increased stress levels
Sleep and appetite affected，降低复原力
Tense relationships with colleagues，形成负性循环

target_behavior.behavior: 工作挫败后出现灾难化思维与对not yet来的极度负性Anticipation，伴随Anxiety与担忧
antecedent: 在工作中丢失一笔销售
午休的安静时刻容易陷入负面思维
连续多次丢单后的业绩与收入压力
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessively focuses on the consequences of failure and generalizes a single setback into persistent failure, predicting the family will therefore have a bad holiday and life
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失望与not确定性，试图通过预演最坏情形获得心理上的控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、Tense relationships with colleagues、Sleep and appetite affected，整体心理健康下降
